hotels.description: In the form of a palm tree extending out into the ocean, Golden Palm Tree Malaysia epitomises paradise with its beachfront location and Polynesian-style overwater villas. Sun-soaked days can be spent swimming in the infinity pool or relaxing with a signature massage or body scrub at Lin Spa. If you have little ones in tow, make their day by dropping them off at Tiki Tots Kids Club for supervised fun. Meanwhile, the four exceptional dining venues are sure to satisfy any craving.
